Non-Key Expert – Gender Equality & Social Inclusion Specialist

NTU International is preparing a proposal for the project “Support to the Africa-EU Space Partnership Programme – AESPP Boost.”

The programme aims to strengthen cooperation between Africa and the European Union in the space sector, supporting policy dialogue, institutional partnerships, knowledge exchange, innovation, private sector engagement and investment, while contributing to stronger and more sustainable African space ecosystems.

In this context, we are seeking a highly qualified Non-Key Expert – Gender Equality & Social Inclusion Specialist to support the systematic integration of gender equality and social inclusion considerations across programme activities, ensuring inclusive participation, gender-responsive implementation and equitable access to opportunities generated through Africa-EU space cooperation.

Minimum Qualifications and Skills

• University degree at Master’s level in gender studies, social sciences, development studies, or a related field.

• Excellent command of English.

• Working knowledge of French and/or Portuguese will be considered an asset.

Minimum General Professional Experience

• Minimum 8 years of professional experience in gender equality, social inclusion and/or inclusive development in international cooperation.

Minimum Specific Professional Experience

• At least 4 years of professional experience designing and applying gender-responsive approaches in donor-funded programmes, including gender analysis, sex-disaggregated indicators, inclusive stakeholder participation, training and/or gender-responsive communication. Familiarity with EU external-action gender policy and experience in Africa are assets.

If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply and upload your CV via LinkedIn or send to recruitment@ntu.eu. Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted due to the large amount of applicants.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As Senior Manager, Front-End Portfolio Management, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future growth of Sensing Solutions. You will lead our Front-End Engine and growth opportunity portfolio, helping identify where we should invest next across technologies, markets, partnerships, and business models.

Working at the intersection of technology, customer insights, and business strategy, you will turn emerging trends, customer needs, and strategic priorities into actionable growth opportunities. Your recommendations will influence critical investment decisions and help ensure we focus our resources on the opportunities with the greatest potential to create customer value and accelerate business growth.

Sensing Solutions, part of Danfoss Climate Solutions, develops sensor technologies that help customers improve efficiency, performance, and sustainability. In this role, you'll help define the future direction of the business while contributing to technologies that support the global energy transition and reduce climate impact.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Own and continuously enhance the Sensing Front-End Engine and portfolio governance processes, ensuring transparency, alignment, and effective decision-making across the organization

• Build, maintain, and prioritize a portfolio of growth opportunities by translating customer needs, market trends, emerging technologies, and strategic priorities into validated investment opportunities

• Lead selected strategic initiatives, including new business opportunities, strategic partnerships, and M&A-related assessments, from early exploration through recommendation and decision-making

• Drive portfolio prioritization and resource allocation discussions, ensuring investment decisions are aligned with business priorities, available resources, and long-term growth ambitions

• Partner closely with Product Management, Segment Management, Commercial, R&D, Supply Chain, and senior leaders to accelerate opportunity development, strengthen alignment, and support execution

You will also help build Front-End capabilities across the organization by coaching opportunity owners and promoting a consistent, evidence-based approach to opportunity evaluation and portfolio management.

**What We're Looking For

**

• A degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field, combined with significant experience in strategy, business development, product management, portfolio management, or similar commercial roles within a technology-driven organization

• Proven experience identifying, validating, and developing growth opportunities, turning market insights, customer needs, and business objectives into clear recommendations, business cases, and investment priorities

• Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to make sound decisions in complex environments and balance opportunity potential with business priorities and resource constraints

• Experience working across functions and influencing stakeholders in areas such as engineering, sales, operations, supply chain, and senior leadership

• A collaborative and proactive mindset, with the ability to build networks, create alignment, and help teams move from ideas to decisions and results

Experience with sensing technologies, particularly pressure, gas, or temperature sensing, is an advantage. Knowledge of the HVACR, data center, water, or off-highway industries, as well as experience with strategic partnerships, business development, or M&A activities, would also be beneficial.

As many of our primary stakeholders are located in Nordborg you will be expected to be on site frequently to build a strong relation with them.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

This is a unique opportunity to influence the long-term growth strategy of a global business, working on some of the most important decisions shaping the future of Sensing Solutions. You'll collaborate with senior leaders, gain exposure across the value chain, and help bring new technologies, partnerships, and business opportunities to life.

We promote development from within and support learning through collaboration, mentoring, training and access to global opportunities.

You will have flexibility, autonomy and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. We strive to create an inclusive working environment where people of different backgrounds and perspectives are respected and valued.

Benefits may include annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance and other locally applicable benefits.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

For information about the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Gerd Veierskov, +45 3057 1882

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Department: R&D

Location: Copenhagen

**Description

**Factbird helps manufacturers turn real-time production data into decisions they can actually act on. Since 2016, we've helped manufacturers in 28 countries cut waste, boost uptime, and run smarter — from the shop floor to the boardroom. Over 300 companies trust us to make sense of their operations, and we're a team of 80+ people across Copenhagen and the US who care about making complex things simple.

We're creating a new role at the top of our Engineering career ladder: Lead Architect. It's the senior end of our Technical Track — the rung above Tech Lead — and today it's a role we've deliberately left lightly defined, because we want the first person in it to help define it. You'll set Factbird's technical direction: architecture, tooling, and the multi-year technology bets that shape where the product goes next.

This is our most senior technical role, with no direct reports — your authority comes from judgment and track record, not the org chart. You'll work alongside our Tech Leads in Factbird's technical leadership group, partner closely with our Director of Engineering, and be the person other senior engineers go to when a decision is genuinely hard to reverse.

**About the Role

**As Lead Architect, you own Factbird's company-wide technical vision: the architecture our services run on, the tooling and standards our engineers use every day, and the multi-year technology strategy that ties it all together. You make — or sign off on — the high-stakes, hard-to-reverse architecture calls, and you're accountable for getting them right with the full context of where the business is headed, not just where the code is today.

You'll work across a team built on Rust, React, Node.js, and AWS, with AI-assisted development already a core part of how we ship. Some of what this role owns is already well-defined — reviewing RFCs, stewarding language and platform standards, setting the team's AI-tooling strategy. Some of it isn't yet: Factbird is still a growing company, and part of the job is helping us figure out what technical leadership at this level should look like as we scale.

You'll thrive here if you'd rather be trusted with genuinely hard calls than manage a team, and if you can hold both the technical detail and the commercial context — cost, risk, market direction — well enough to make a technology bet you can still defend a year later.

**

What you'll do

**Architecture & technical strategy

• Own Factbird's multi-year technology strategy, and make the high-stakes architecture calls that are hard to reverse — with cost, risk, and business context factored in, not just engineering elegance

• Author and drive major RFCs from proposal through to an actual decision, and review the highest-risk architecture changes across the team

• Act as steward for our core languages and frameworks — setting standards, library choices, and the platform's overall shape

• Make build-vs-buy calls for new technical capabilities, and bring a clear point of view on emerging technologies worth adopting

• Define the observability, reliability, and security posture the platform is held to

**

Tooling & standards**

• Set the team's technical tooling and platform standards, and keep them evolving as the stack and the company grow

• Define Factbird's strategy for AI-assisted development — which tools we adopt, how we balance velocity against code quality, security, and IP risk, and where we draw the line

• Shape engineering-wide quality philosophy and help set the technical bar used in hiring interviews

• Help define shared components and reference architecture that other engineers build on, rather than reinvent

• Give input into technical org design and team topology as Engineering scales

**

Technical leadership & mentorship**

• Act as the trusted technical advisor to our Director of Engineering and the technical leadership group, partnering with Tech Leads and Product Leads on cross-team alignment

• Mentor senior engineers and Tech Leads toward architect-level thinking, without formal ownership of their people management

• Communicate technical vision and trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including leadership

• Identify technical risks to the business early, and say so before they become expensive

• Represent Factbird's technical thinking externally where it makes sense — a talk, a blog post, an open-source contribution — though this isn't a requirement on day one

**What we’re looking for

**We're looking for someone who's already earned this kind of trust somewhere else — someone whose technical opinions carry weight because they're right more often than not, and who'd rather solve the interesting, ambiguous problem than manage the team solving it.

**

The ideal background**

• 8+ years of hands-on engineering experience, including real time spent as an architect or equivalent senior technical authority, not just a senior engineer with a bigger title

• A track record of owning multi-year technology strategy or platform architecture decisions that other teams had to live with — and that held up

• Has led major RFCs or architecture proposals cross-team, through genuine pushback, to an actual decision

• Comfortable making build-vs-buy and technology-adoption calls that account for cost, risk, and where the market is heading, not just what's technically interesting

• Experience mentoring senior engineers or Tech Leads toward architect-level thinking, without needing formal authority to do it

• Practical, current experience with AI-assisted development, and a clear point of view on where it genuinely helps versus where it creates risk

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

**

Here's what you can look forward to:**

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn't one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We'll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we'll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide gatherings & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what's next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We're proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**

We'd love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we'd be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out to Cristina Vartej at **crva@factbird.com

**_

At Factbird, we believe that great work starts with people feeling respected, valued, and included. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

__All employment decisions at Factbird are made based on business needs, role requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination based on gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital or family status, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable European and local employment laws.

_We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make our teams stronger and our work better. We warmly encourage all qualified candidates to apply and to bring their whole selves to Factbird.

Join us in building the foundation of next generation hearing device platforms.

_Are you passionate about firmware close to the metal? Do you enjoy understanding how hardware really works and applying your expertise to build stable, efficient real time embedded systems? Would you like your work to make a real difference for millions of people living with hearing loss worldwide?

If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

About The Team

You will join our Foundation Firmware area within the R&D Device SW organization — a group of about 25 highly skilled engineers working in three scrum teams. Together we build and maintain the low level firmware that forms the foundation of all Demant hearing device software platforms.

We work closely with hardware, software and production teams throughout every stage of platform development. The atmosphere in the team is informal, friendly, and highly engaged. We believe the best results come from a fruitful team effort. We support each other, provide constructive feedback, and share knowledge and ideas to continuously improve our solutions and reach common goals.

What You Will Be Working On

Our work spans the full development flow of a resource-constrained platform — from IC specification and early bring-up, through development, verification, and production, all the way to product release. This means working in simulations, on FPGA prototypes, and on real silicon as our platforms mature. Our chipsets are internally developed, multi-core network-on-chip solutions designed for ultra-low-power audio. Our firmware platform includes hardware drivers and HAL, RTOS integration, power management, file handling, communication stacks, security, firmware update functionality and more.

You will design, develop, test, and release firmware for our custom ICs, working closely with other embedded software, hardware, production, and verification teams. Your focus will be on delivering advanced functionality with real-time guarantees for the system, while always balancing memory consumption, compute cycles, and power efficiency to meet the high standards of medical devices. This means writing safe, efficient C code that enables our hearing devices to perform reliably in highly resource-constrained environments. You will use and help improve specialized in-house tools that assist the development process, as well as automated regression tests that safeguard stability and performance of our platform as it evolves.

In summary, your main responsibilities will be to:

• 
Design, develop and test efficient firmware for our chipset platform

• 
Support hardware and production teams in bring up, calibration and verification

• 
Contribute to the definition and development of our internally developed ICs

• 
Implement safe and efficient C code for real time applications

• 
Help ensure high quality through automated tests and CI/CD

• 
Participate in team ceremonies and knowledge sharing

What You Bring

You hold a degree in Electronics, Computer Engineering, or similar, and you have a solid hands-on experience – at least 3 years – within the following areas of embedded SW development:

• 
Embedded C programming for memory , power and time constrained systems

• 
Understanding of processor architectures and MCUs

• 
Real time operating systems (RTOS) and real-time handling of HW

• 
Reading HW schematics

• 
Working with measurement instruments such as logic analyzers or oscilloscopes

• 
Automated unit and system testing

• 
Version control systems (git)

• 
Linux, scripting and custom toolchains

You take pride in building high-quality, maintainable code and are comfortable working in large, shared code repositories with comprehensive testing and a complex build flow. You can work independently, but you also enjoy collaborating within the team and across teams to achieve the best results.

Why Demant?

At Demant, we believe in balancing professional passion with a fulfilling personal life. Our flexible hybrid work model allows you to work from home up to two days per week. Each morning, you can enjoy complimentary breakfast, and lunch is provided daily in our canteen. To support your well-being, you will have access to fitness facilities, weekly training sessions, and massage services. If you are parent, we offer attractive parental benefits, including the option to stay home when your young child is unwell. Above all, we prioritize a respectful and inclusive workplace culture where colleagues support one another, and everyone feels valued.

How To Apply

This is a full time position located at our headquarters in Smørum, Greater Copenhagen area. (Please note: We are not considering part time, consultant, or internship contracts for this role.)

Please submit your CV and a short motivation via our online portal no later than October 30th, 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis. If you have questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Maja Lončar, Senior Manager System Firmware, at mjln@demant.com.

We expect to conduct first-round interviews in weeks 44-45 and second-round interviews in weeks 45-46.

At Demant we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

Do you want to help build one coherent way for a global technology organization to deliver, bringing scaled product-centric ways of working project and program execution _together into a single system, rather than running them as separate worlds? Are you as comfortable helping shape that system and turning it into ways of working people actually use in the room with the people who'll actually use it?_We are hiring a Manager, Delivery Enablement to help shape and evolve how Pandora's D&T organization delivers. D&T spans the full range of technology that keeps Pandora running: from customer-facing platforms to manufacturing systems, ERP, logistics and operations, security, covering build, run, and operate across all of it. This role does not carry people-management responsibility. Your impact comes through the quality of what you build and how well it lands across the organization.

You'll join Delivery Enablement, a team combining operating-model design and implementation, coaching, and delivery tooling capability. It's built to make Digital & Technology (D&T) faster, clearer, and more coherent at scale. Delivery Enablement sits within Delivery Excellence, alongside the Scrum Masters, Delivery Leads, and Project and Program Managers. You will work with the wider team to shape ideas and turn them into practical ways of working across D&T.

**Your Role

**You will help harmonize and evolve how scaled agile delivery and more structured, plan-driven delivery work together, building on what already exists across D&T rather than replacing it, closing gaps only where they cause real friction. This is as much about leading change as it is about designing structure. You will also advise on structuring new or reshaping delivery entities (product lines, programs, organizational changes, or other setups) as they take shape, and help teams and entities build the capability to adopt the model as it evolves.

You will work closely with the wider delivery community, as well as product, engineering, and leadership more broadly, to facilitate structural workshops, build the case for change, and make sure what gets designed is something people actually want to use, not just a document on a shelf. A key part of the role is building the relationships, networks and momentum needed to bring ideas to life across D&T.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Co-design and evolve how scaled agile and structured, plan-driven delivery work together, harmonizing and building on existing practice rather than replacing it

• Advise on structuring new or reshaping delivery entities (product lines, programs, organizational changes, or other setups) as they take shape

• Lead workstreams that take new or improved delivery processes (for example dependency management or capacity planning) from idea through pilot, rollout, adoption and continuous improvement

• Support onboarding and capability-building for teams and entities adopting the model, working alongside the team's wider coaching capability

• Facilitate structural workshops and working sessions with the wider delivery community to shape and pressure-test the model

• Build relationships, networks and communities that help change spread and stick across D&T

• Pilot approaches, learn from feedback, and scale what works

• Help translate high-level decisions about how delivery is prioritized, funded, resourced, and executed into practical structures and standards teams can use

• Help projects and programs connect into the wider D&T Operating Model, including common governance, planning, dependency management and delivery tooling

• Contribute to keeping the model coherent as it evolves, spotting where new structures overlap or conflict with what already exists

• Provide point-in-time advisory support where operating-model gaps are most costly

• Document how the operating model works and how it evolves over time

• Build strong relationships across the wider delivery community and leadership to ensure what gets built is genuinely adopted

**What Is Needed To Succeed

**

• ignificant experience in delivery transformation, operating-model implementation, PMO, program/project delivery or organizational change within a large, complex technology organization

• Demonstrated experience working across both scaled/product-centric agile delivery and more structured, plan-driven delivery, with enough understanding to contribute credibly to how they work together

• Track record of taking new ways of working from idea through implementation, adoption and continuous improvement

• Ideally a mix of hands-on delivery experience and consulting or advisory experience, but real, first-hand delivery experience matters more than advisory polish alone

• Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, and narrative-building skills across senior and operational levels

• Comfortable leading through organizational change: helping people, not just structures, adapt as delivery models shift

• Able to build trust, networks and momentum without relying on formal authority

• Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your own analysis, design, and documentation work

• Working understanding of how delivery tooling (e.g. Jira/Confluence, or equivalent) underpins an operating model, enough to design frameworks that translate into practice, not to configure the tooling yourself

• Comfortable operating in ambiguity: building on foundations already in motion, while still shaping significant parts of the model from scratch

• Systems thinking: able to see cross-domain and cross-entity dependencies, not just local fixes

• Pragmatic bias toward incremental, adoptable change over comprehensive upfront design

• Relevant certifications (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe) are an advantage

**Did we get your attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s experience & ambitions.Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Are you a Test consultant with a passion for Software and with an international mindset? Would you like to use your testing expertise while working closely with our customers? Then you could be the new colleague we’re looking for.

As a Test consultant at Keylane, you will work with Plexus, our core Pension Platform. You will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our solutions. You will optimize the solution for existing customers as well as supporting implementations for new clients. By visiting customers at their offices in Greater Copenhagen, you will gain a clear understanding of their needs and ensure our solutions meet the highest quality standards. Your work will have a direct impact on the quality of our product. By combining your testing expertise with interpersonal skills, you will help us to build the right solutions from the outset and identify and resolve defects early in the development process.

Key about your role

You will:

• Perform regression testing of core pension functionality, including underlying calculations, across customers and products.

• Investigate deviations and test results, analyse the underlying data and calculations, and provide clear and accurate insights that help the team identify root causes and resolve issues.

• Test new features and functionality to ensure they meet both functional requirements and expected business outcomes.

• Provide pension calculations and testing.

• Identify opportunities to improve both our product and the way we test it.

• Contribute ideas and initiatives related to test automation and the use of AI in testing.

• Take an active role in our ongoing test improvement programme and help strengthen our overall approach to quality assurance.

Key about your team

You are part of our new Customer Support and Operation (CSO) department together with many driven and experienced colleagues. As a part of the CSO department, You will join the Release Management team, a group dedicated to ensuring the smooth delivery of our pension software releases to customers. The team is responsible for testing and verifying that each release is ready for deployment. You work in a team composed of various expertise (pension-related, actuarial, technical) in which you support our Product Development teams, project teams and the customers. You will work in a mixed team, i.e. with the local Dutch, Danish and Indian team, each with their own expertise.

Key about you

We are looking for someone who enjoys working with complex systems, data and calculations and thrives on collaborating across international teams.

Ideally, you have:

• An educational background in in math, IT or a related field.

• At least +3 years experience in software testing or data analysis.

• Experience with or knowledge of the pension industry – this is a strong advantage.

• Experience with SQL or are comfortable working with databases and data analysis.

• Have a hands-on mindset, take ownership and are comfortable driving tasks and issues forward.

• Strong numerical and analytical skills, as many of the tasks involve working extensively with data and calculations.

• Communicate confidently in both Danish and English.

Other information

Please submit your application, including your CV. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

Each employee within Keylane must follow training on information security and irrespective to the role basic information security responsibilities apply.

Benefits

• A flat and informal organization with a professional and supportive working environment.

• A profit share.

• Inclusion days where you decide when to hold your public holidays.

• Five weeks of vacation and five Keylane days.

• A pension scheme where 13.25% is paid by Keylane and the individual contribution is 3%.

• Flexibility in the working environment. We offer a combination of working from home and from the office. We value seeing colleagues in person to stay connected and collaborate effectively.

• The Danish office is located a 10-minute walk from Islands Brygge Metro station.

• We believe that strong employee relations are key to maintaining well-being in the workplace. To support this, we offer a variety of social activities that all employees can participate in, such as yoga, padel tennis, running, outdoor bathing, and fitness in the basement.

**Role Description

The candidate will act as the commercial, professional and cultural leader within the Supply Chain domain and will work closely with fellow Partners in the leadership team to strengthen Unify Partner's overall market position.

The ideal candidate is able to bridge industry and consulting, drive business development initiatives and diversify our client portfolio, lead complex transformation projects and provide people-oriented leadership across both external projects and internal initiatives.

****Business Development

**

• Expand and commercialise Unify Partner's position within the Supply Chain advisory area through clear subject matter expertise and strong client relationships.

• Win and lead large transformation programmes spanning the intersection of Supply Chain Excellence, ERP and Data/AI.

**Strategy

**

• Ensure the unification and development of Supply Chain & Operations and ERP as a core service offering area

• Contribute to building new growth areas for Unify Partners, particularly within AI & Supply Chain

**People & Leadership

**

• Strengthen and maintain engagement, professional development and retention among consultants within the SC&O service offering area.

• Ensure cohesion across the Supply Chain offering and Unify Partner's other service offerings

• Provide employees with clear professional and cultural leadership.

**Key Responsibilities

****Commercial Development

**

• Drive sales, pipeline development and relationship building with key clients

• Develop strategic relationships at CxO level and translate expertise into business for Unify Partners

• Develop proposals and commercial offerings within the intersection of Supply Chain & ERP

• Contribute to building a strong sales and consulting culture at Unify Partners.

**Professional & Strategic Development

**

• Further develop the Supply Chain area as a primary discipline and ERP & Business Solutions as a secondary - but closely related - discipline.

• Lead Supply Chain projects including: End-to-End Supply Chain Design, Demand Planning, Supply Planning and Inventory Planning, ERP Replacements and Implementations, In-and Outsourcing Initiatives and ensuring process maturity before technology shifts.

• Contribute to the development of new Service Offering overlaps with Supply Chain, with a special focus on AI & Supply Chain for example: AI-based optimisation solutions in production and use of data, sensors, and visual technologies to drive performance improvements.

Leadership & People Development

• Professionally lead consultants with both direct and indirect responsibilities in project settings.

• Build strong working relationships through continuous dialogue, support, and regular touchpoints.

• Ensure alignment between leadership values and day-to-day behaviours.

**Qualifications, We Hope You Will Bring

****Background

**

• 
Engineering degree (i.e. DTU) or MSc in Supply Chain Management (CBS)

• 
Strong combination of industry experience and external consulting experience. Candidates are expected to have more than 8 years experience.

• 
Proven advanced consulting toolkit, demonstrated through consistent origination of work, trusted CxO relationships, sponsorship of complex deliveries, development of senior consultants, and contribution to firm‑level growth and culture.

• 
Experience from industrial or manufacturing environments (potentially MedTech).

• 
Fluent in Danish and English.

**Subject Matter Expertise

**

• 
Supply Chain expertise as the primary area of subject matter expertise including:

• 
Supply chain strategies

• 
Supply chain planning

• 
Warehouse management

• 
Network optimisation

• 
ERP as a secondary area of expertise

• 
Experience with ERP rollouts, particularly in the context of Supply Chain processes

• 
Understanding of the interplay between production and warehouse operations.

• 
Experience with in- and outsourcing.

**Technical Skills

**

• Solid data understanding and confidence working with large data sets

• Knowledge of PowerBI and general data visualisation tools

• Hands-on understanding of ERP systems and comfortable working directly in the systems

• Strong working knowledge of the Supply Chain module in either Microsoft Dynamics 365 or SAP.

**Leadership Experience

**

• Relationally strong and able to build a sense of team cohesion and invest time in colleagues personal and professional development

• Thrives at the intersection of deep expertise and business development.

**What We Offer

**

• A vibrant and growing company where your voice matters. You’ll have real influence over how we work, collaborate, and evolve.

• A company that believes that rest is productive. Our working policies are built on trust, autonomy, and psychological safety with flexibility being a keyword.

**Most of what we do comes down to one hard thing: turning the world's messy, unstructured supplier data into something you can score.

We scrape it, extract it, resolve the entities, normalise it, and put a number on it, at a scale where a single customer can have 100,000 suppliers.

That means real problems, not ticket-shaped ones. Extraction pipelines where the LLM is confidently wrong 5% of the time and you have to decide what to do about it. Entity resolution where "Nordic Steel A/S" and "NORDIC STEEL" and "Nordisk Stål" may or may not be the same company. Schema design for data that arrives in a different shape every time.
